extracted.intended_audience: investors, financial analysts, media, and customers
extracted.subtask_description: A public company's investor-facing press release announcing quarterly and full-year financial results, operational highlights, executive commentary, legal disclosures, and guidance for investors and the media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline
rubrics_metrics.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2015 Results; CDC Investigation Over; Chipotle Welcomes Customers Back to Restaurants
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The headline should clearly state the issuer and the primary news (earnings results) and may include a timely news hook or reputational message (e.g., 'CDC Investigation Over; ... Welcomes Customers Back').

rubrics_metrics.name: Dateline and distribution service
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include city, distribution service (Business Wire), and date at the top of the release to establish timing and distribution channel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Company identification and ticker
rubrics_metrics.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. (NYSE: CMG) today reported financial results for its fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2015.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify the company by full legal name and provide the public ticker symbol when applicable so investors/media can quickly recognize the issuer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead stating reporting period
rubrics_metrics.description: reported financial results for its fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2015.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State clearly which reporting period(s) the release covers (quarter, full year) and the exact period end date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quarterly highlights (key metrics summary)
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlights for the fourth quarter of 2015 as compared to the fourth quarter of 2014 include: Revenue decreased 6.8% to $997.5 million; Comparable restaurant sales decreased 14.6%; Restaurant level operating margin was 19.6%, a decrease of 700 basis points; Net income was $67.9 million, a decrease of 44.0%; Diluted earnings per share was $2.17, a decrease of 43.5%; Opened 79 new restaurants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise bullet/list summary of the most important quarter-over-quarter metrics (revenue, comparable sales, margins, net income, EPS, unit growth), including percent changes and dollar amounts where relevant, compared to the prior period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full-year highlights
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlights for the twelve months ended December 31, 2015 as compared to the prior year include: Revenue increased 9.6% to $4.5 billion; Comparable restaurant sales increased 0.2%; Restaurant level operating margin was 26.1%, a decrease of 110 basis points; Net income was $475.6 million, an increase of 6.8%; Diluted earnings per share was $15.10, an increase of 6.9%; Opened 229 new restaurants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a comparable summary for the full year, with the same key metrics as the quarterly highlights and explicit comparisons to the prior year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive quotes addressing issues and plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Quotes from executives (Steve Ells, Monty Moran) discussing CDC conclusion, enhanced food safety plan, focus on execution, restoring customer confidence, and expectations for the company.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include at least one executive quote that (a) contextualizes the results or recent events, (b) describes actions or strategy (e.g., enhanced food safety program), and (c) provides messaging intended to reassure stakeholders and outline next steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed results narrative and explanations
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative sections (e.g., 'Fourth quarter 2015 results') explain drivers: decrease in comparable restaurant sales due to publicity around food-borne illness incidents; food cost drivers (dairy, avocado, beef relief), impacts of menu price increases, food waste and testing; margin and G&A explanations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a prose explanation of the numeric results that links changes in metrics to business drivers (publicity, commodity prices, price increases, operating costs) and notes any one-time or non-recurring items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of material legal matters and cooperation
rubrics_metrics.description: On January 28, 2016, Chipotle was served with a subpoena broadening the scope of the previously-announced criminal investigation by the U.S. Attorney’s office for the Central District of California... We intend to fully cooperate in the investigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose material legal or regulatory developments (date, scope, jurisdiction), their potential relevance, and the company's intended response or cooperation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Share repurchase program disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Board of Directors has approved the investment of up to an additional $300 million, exclusive of commissions, to repurchase shares of our common stock. This repurchase authorization... may be modified, suspended, or discontinued at any time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When announcing buyback authorizations, state the approved amount, how it relates to prior authorizations, and caveats that the program may be modified or discontinued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outlook and forward-looking metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: For 2016, management expects the following: 220-235 new restaurant openings; An effective full year tax rate of approximately 39.0%.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specific forward-looking guidance where available (ranges or point estimates) and identify the metric(s) covered (unit openings, tax rate, revenue guidance, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Forward-looking statements disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain statements in this press release... are forward-looking statements as defined in the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. We use words such as 'anticipate', 'believe', 'could', 'should', 'estimate', 'expect', 'intend', 'may', 'predict', 'project', 'target'... These statements are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially from those described... risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the following: ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a PSLRA-compliant cautionary statement identifying that forward-looking language is used, listing typical risk factors or referring readers to SEC filings for fuller descriptions of risks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions of terms used in the release
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions: 'Comparable restaurant sales represent the change in period-over-period sales for restaurants in operation for at least 13 full calendar months.' 'Average restaurant sales refers to the average trailing 12-month sales for restaurants in operation for at least 12 full calendar months.' 'Restaurant level operating margin represents total revenue less restaurant operating costs, expressed as a percent of total revenue.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define any specialized or non-standard metrics used in the release so readers understand the calculation and the population to which they apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference call and webcast details
rubrics_metrics.description: Conference Call: Chipotle will host a conference call ... on Tuesday, February 2, 2016 at 5:00 PM Eastern time. The conference call can be accessed live over the phone by dialing 1-888-523-1232... A replay will be available... password is 214044. The call will be webcast live from the company's website at chipotle.com under the investor relations section. An archived webcast will be available approximately one hour after the end of the call.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide date/time, dial-in numbers (domestic and international), replay instructions and dates, webcast link and location (investor relations page), and any passwords or access codes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of audited/unaudited financial tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Condensed Consolidated Statement of Income and Comprehensive Income (three months and year ended Dec 31, 2015 and 2014), Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheet, Condensed Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows — all with line-item detail and percentage-of-revenue presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include relevant financial statements (condensed as appropriate) with comparable prior-period data, line-item breakdowns (food, labor, occupancy, G&A, depreciation, pre-opening costs, etc.), and clear labeling of whether data are unaudited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental financial and operational data
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplemental Financial and Other Data table: Number of restaurants opened; Restaurant relocations; Number of restaurants at end of period; Average restaurant sales; Comparable restaurant sales increase (decrease) by quarter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide supplemental operational metrics and trends (unit development, average unit sales, comparable store sales by quarter) to give context beyond the primary financial statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source citation and investor relations contact
rubrics_metrics.description: View source version on businesswire.com: http://... Source: Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. Investor Relations: Mark Alexee, 303-605-1042
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a source citation or link to the distributed version of the release and provide a named investor relations/media contact with phone number for follow-up.
